verdict.rationale: Elicit's Systematic Reviews workflow explicitly walks through setup, gathering papers, title/abstract screening, and data extraction with customizable columns applied consistently across all papers, plus exportable screening/extraction tables — directly matching the story (elicit-docs-1, elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-18, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-14). Community feedback confirms usefulness for literature overviews but also flags accuracy concerns (~90% accuracy target, hallucinated summaries) that a researcher must verify, and Elicit itself instructs users to check outputs closely (elicit-comm-1, elicit-comm-2, elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent verification that extraction stays consistent at scale across large paper sets, and third-party audits of screening accuracy/precision-recall.
